item.title: Getting Lost In “Translations”: A New Take On An Irish Classic
item.description: Brian Friel’s Translations is one of the most significant Irish plays of the 20th century. Written at the height of The Troubles, but set in the 1830s, it mourns the loss of the native Irish language whilst raising a much-deserved middle finger at Ireland’s former colonial occupiers.
